query:
INSERT INTO job_assignments (jobId, userId, role, assignedAt, assignedByUserId)
SELECT 
  id as jobId,
  assignedTechnicianId as userId,
  'LEAD' as role,
  assignedAt,
  assignedByUserId
FROM jobs
WHERE assignedTechnicianId IS NOT NULL
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM job_assignments ja 
    WHERE ja.jobId = jobs.id AND ja.userId = jobs.assignedTechnicianId
  );
